joint_support_rule: all 8 states observed in representation-fit and source-validation; otherwise omit joint output from both rich banks and report limitation
weighted_sensitivity: PWGTP-weighted final metrics on identical selected predictions only
task_selection: minimum downstream-validation log loss across logistic C1 and one fixed MLP; report both
attack_selection: minimum attacker-validation log loss across logistic C1, one MLP, one HistGB; report all
practical_transfer_effect: 0.01 nats lower held-out log loss; descriptive, not significance or admission threshold
sealed_test_rule: save every release and head/attack selection before reading test outcomes for scoring
